title: List of 2020 box office number-one films in the United States
wikitext:
{{Short description|None}} {{Use mdy dates|date=April 2025}} This is a list of films which placed number one at the weekend [[box office]] for the year [[2020 in film|2020]].{{cite web|url=https://www.boxofficemojo.com/weekend/by-year/2020/|work=[[Box Office Mojo]] |title=Domestic Box Office Weekends For 2020}} The year was severely impacted by the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. The vast majority of theaters around the country closed in March, and grosses plummeted. Many number one films during the height of the closures were independent films with limited releases, and films were primarily viewed through [[Drive-in theater|drive-in theaters.]]{{Cite web|url=https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/488485-drive-in-movie-theaters-see-resurgence-during-coronavirus/|title=Drive-in movie theaters see resurgence during coronavirus|last=Budryk|first=Zack|date=March 19, 2020|website=The Hill}} Total grosses from all movies combined in 2020 generated $2.28 billion in the United States, an 80% decline from 2019's $11.4 billion.{{Cite web|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/its-official-2020-domestic-box-office-fell-80-percent-to-2-3b-behind-chinas-2-7b-4110745/|title=It’s Official: 2020 Domestic Box Office Fell 80 Percent to $2.3B Behind China's $2.7B|date=January 1, 2021|website=The Hollywood Reporter|last=McClintock|first=Pamela}} ==Number-one films== {| class="wikitable" |style="background-color:#FFFF99"align="center"|† |This implies the highest-grossing movie of the year. |} {| class="wikitable sortable" ! {{abbr|#|Week number}} ! extract:
This is a list of films which placed number one at the weekend box office for the year 2020.
The year was severely impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic. The vast majority of theaters around the country closed in March, and grosses plummeted. Many number one films during the height of the closures were independent films with limited releases, and films were primarily viewed through drive-in theaters. Total grosses from all movies combined in 2020 generated $2.28 billion in the United States, an 80% decline from 2019's $11.4 billion.
